name: 32789 · Winter Park, FL
findings: ZIP 32789 (Winter Park) has 255 nonprofit organizations. 96 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32789 (Winter Park) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32789 (Winter Park) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
